name: Rocket Bites - 200mg Edible Gummies - Cotton Clouds
description:
Big flavor in a small bite. Rocket Bites Cotton Clouds gummies deliver that nostalgic cotton candy taste — light, sugary-sweet, and melt-in-your-mouth smooth in every piece.

Each pack contains 10 gummies at 20mg each — 200mg total — so it's easy to dial in exactly the dose you want. Perfectly soft, perfectly sweet, and ready whenever you are.

10 gummies × 20mg — 200mg per pack
Sweet Cotton Clouds flavor — fluffy, sugary cotton candy
Easy to portion — consistent dosing in every piece

Start low, go slow, and enjoy the ride.
